systems.system: SIGIT (Integrated Tax and Duty Management System)

CMR.note: The tax administration is said to rely on multiple applications, with no core system stated in use or down; SIGIT is a contract awarded, not in use.
Only DGI's own data centres, with no hire to outside customers stated.
Online taxpayer services are only expected from SIGIT, not in service.
DGI data centres serve DGI only; no data centre for hire stated.

facts.fact: Business in Cameroon reports the Finance Minister approved on 10 April 2026 a EUR 5.997m contract for SIGIT, a new tax management system that will support taxpayer registration, with 24 months of implementation under the KfW-financed PMSI-DGI programme.
